Title: Permit on site
ConditionText: The permittee shall keep a copy of this permit, including all conditions and attachments, at the work or activity site at all times and shall present it to any authorized official upon request.

Title: Scope limited to permit
ConditionText: Activities are limited to the dates, location, and scope described in this permit. Any change in dates, location, methods, or scope requires written approval before the change is made.

Title: Compliance with laws
ConditionText: The permittee shall comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, regulations, and ordinances, and shall obtain any other permits or approvals required for the activity.

Title: Site restoration
ConditionText: Upon completion of the activity, the permittee shall remove all equipment, materials, and debris and restore the site to its pre-activity condition, or better, to the satisfaction of the issuing office.

Title: Certificate of insurance
ConditionText: The permittee shall maintain commercial general liability insurance in the amount specified in the permit for the full term of the permit, naming the issuing agency as additional insured. A current certificate of insurance must be on file before any activity begins.

Title: Indemnification
ConditionText: The permittee shall indemnify and hold harmless the issuing agency, its officers, and employees from any claims, damages, or losses arising from the permittee's activities under this permit.

Title: Inadvertent discovery – stop work
ConditionText: If any archaeological, historic, or cultural materials, or human remains, are discovered during the activity, the permittee shall immediately stop all work within 100 feet of the discovery, protect the area, and notify the issuing office. Work shall not resume in that area until written authorization is given.

Title: No collection of artifacts
ConditionText: The permittee shall not disturb, remove, or collect any artifacts, historic objects, or cultural materials.

Title: Erosion and sediment control
ConditionText: Before any ground disturbance, the permittee shall install and maintain erosion and sediment control measures (such as silt fence, straw wattles, or equivalent) and shall keep them in effective condition until disturbed areas are stabilized.

Title: Topsoil and revegetation
ConditionText: Topsoil removed during excavation shall be stockpiled separately and replaced. Disturbed areas shall be reseeded with an approved native seed mix within 14 days of final grading.

Title: Wet-weather restriction
ConditionText: Vehicles and equipment shall not operate on saturated soils where ruts deeper than 4 inches would result. Work shall be suspended during such conditions.
TriggerImpacts: Motorized equipment or vehicles off road

Title: Riparian buffer protection
ConditionText: No vegetation removal, ground disturbance, equipment staging, or material storage shall occur within 100 feet of any stream, river, or wetland edge unless specifically shown on the approved site plan.
AppliesToTypes: Special Event;Commercial Filming / Photography;Right-of-Way / Utility;Construction / Access;Agricultural Use

Title: No refueling within buffer
ConditionText: Fueling, lubrication, and maintenance of vehicles and equipment shall occur at least 100 feet from any stream, river, or wetland. A spill kit shall be kept on site, and any spill shall be reported to the issuing office immediately.
TriggerImpacts: Motorized equipment or vehicles off road

Title: Tricolored bat seasonal clearing restriction
ConditionText: To protect roosting bats, cutting or removal of trees 3 inches or greater in diameter is prohibited from [START DATE – confirm with biologist] through [END DATE – confirm with biologist]. Any clearing outside this window must be completed as described in the approved site plan.

Title: Tree protection and clearing limits
ConditionText: Clearing limits shall be flagged and approved by the issuing office before any tree cutting. Trees outside the flagged limits shall be protected from damage. Cut material shall be disposed of as directed by the issuing office.

Title: Event safety and crowd management
ConditionText: The permittee shall provide adequate restroom facilities, trash receptacles, first aid, and trained staff for crowd management, and shall keep trails, roads, and emergency access routes open to the public and emergency vehicles at all times.

Title: Temporary structures
ConditionText: Temporary structures, tents, and stages shall be anchored without stakes deeper than 12 inches unless approved, shall comply with applicable fire and building codes, and shall be removed within 48 hours after the activity ends.

Title: Night lighting
ConditionText: Night lighting shall be shielded and directed downward, shall be limited to the work or activity area, and shall be turned off no later than the time stated in the permit.

Title: Filming and photography operations
ConditionText: Filming and photography shall not block public access or use of facilities except as approved in the permit. Crew size, vehicles, and equipment shall not exceed the numbers listed in the permit. No props, sets, or special effects may alter natural features.

Title: Unmanned aircraft (drones)
ConditionText: Drone operations shall be conducted by a certified remote pilot in compliance with all applicable aviation regulations, only within the approved area and times, and shall maintain a minimum distance of 100 feet from visitors, wildlife, and structures not involved in the activity.

Title: Motorized equipment limits
ConditionText: Motorized vehicles and equipment shall remain on existing roads and the approved access route unless off-road travel is shown on the approved site plan. Equipment shall be free of soil and plant material before entering the site to prevent the spread of invasive species.
TriggerImpacts: Motorized equipment or vehicles off road

Title: Utility locate and notification
ConditionText: Before any excavation, the permittee shall request utility locates through the applicable one-call notification system and shall notify the issuing office at least 5 business days before work begins.

Title: Research collection limits
ConditionText: Collection and study activities are limited to the species, quantities, methods, and locations listed in the permit. The permittee shall remove all field equipment, flagging, and markers at the end of the study and shall give the issuing office a summary of results within the time stated in the permit.

Title: Agricultural use limits
ConditionText: Agricultural use is limited to the fields, acreage, and activities described in the permit. The permittee shall not apply pesticides, herbicides, or fertilizers, or bring livestock onto the site, except as approved in writing by the issuing office.
